title: No return time
body: The pencilled route to the house ends at an ammunition collection point; the key ring is tagged 'back before supper,' but no return time is entered.
rival_reading: A field team could have logged a temporary equipment pickup and left its key behind; the note gives no reason for the route being blocked.
gloss: A household collection route has a departure and no recorded return.

title: The tin is for screws
body: The test-plot sample jars lost their labels in the rain. Don't put pesticide samples in the rifle-cleaning tin again; the household still keeps its loose screws there.
rival_reading: An emergency crew could have stored ordinary pest-control samples there while clearing the house; bad labels do not show a program malfunction.
gloss: Unmarked test-plot samples are stored beside household supplies.
